mapper.select: SELECT gc.consent_id AS consentId, gc.patient_id AS patientId, gc.sample_id AS sampleId, gs.sample_no AS sampleNo, gc.consent_type AS consentType, gc.status, gc.signed_at AS signedAt, gc.signed_by_name AS signedByName, gc.expires_at AS expiresAt, gc.created_at AS createdAt FROM genomic_consents gc LEFT JOIN genomic_samples gs ON gs.sample_id = gc.sample_id WHERE 1=1 AND gc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND gc.patient_id = #{patientId} AND gc.status = #{status} ORDER BY gc.consent_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT gc.consent_id AS consentId, gc.tenant_id AS tenantId, gc.patient_id AS patientId, gc.sample_id AS sampleId, gs.sample_no AS sampleNo, gc.consent_type AS consentType, gc.status, gc.signed_at AS signedAt, gc.revoked_at AS revokedAt, gc.expires_at AS expiresAt, gc.signed_by_name AS signedByName, gc.witness_name AS witnessName, gc.note, gc.created_by AS createdBy, gc.created_at AS createdAt, gc.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM genomic_consents gc LEFT JOIN genomic_samples gs ON gs.sample_id = gc.sample_id WHERE gc.consent_id = #{consentId} AND gc.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO genomic_consents (tenant_id, patient_id, sample_id, consent_type, expires_at, note, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{patientId}, #{sampleId}, #{consentType}, #{expiresAt}, #{note}, #{createdBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM genomic_consents WHERE consent_id = #{consentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
